artworks.title: Pendant
artworks.description: This image features intricately designed ornate letters of the alphabet surrounded by elaborate illustrations. The top of the composition shows a cherub riding on an eagle, holding a crown above their head. A ribbon with inscriptions unfurls around the crown, and a sun with a human face is visible in the corner. The letters "A," "F," "D," "H," and another "H" are decorated with classical elements like putti, garlands, and mythological figures. The central panel is adorned with heraldic symbols, angelic figures, and coats of arms. The overall style of the artwork reflects baroque or renaissance decorative artistry, known for its ornamental details and classical themes.

artworks.title: Arms of Charles II, Duc de Mantoue
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a coat of arms held by two angels. The image depicts a shield with various heraldic symbols such as fleur-de-lis, eagles, and geometric designs. The shield is crowned with a detailed crown featuring floral motifs and surrounded by a decorative chain. Two winged angels, dressed in robes, stand on either side holding the chain. The background has fine lines and the word "FIDES" is inscribed above.

artworks.title: The Four Evangelists
artworks.description: The image shows four elderly men around a table. They have long hair and beards, and appear focused as they write or take notes on tablets. They wear classical robes and sit in different postures, engaged in writing or possibly calculating. Two hold writing implements and tablets, while a third holds a scroll. Above them, a seated figure with wings is present. Light rays emanate from a dove at the top, highlighting a celestial influence. An eagle is perched nearby. Architectural elements like columns and arches are in the background. A lion's head is under the table.

artworks.title: Mater Dolorosa
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with their head and upper shoulders visible. The person is facing forward with their head slightly tilted upwards and to the side, looking into the distance. Their facial features include a pronounced brow, closed lips, and eyes looking upwards. They have smooth, light skin and dark hair mostly covered by a draped cloth, which envelops their head and neck. The person wears simple, monochrome clothing resembling classical or religious attire. They are not holding any objects or wearing noticeable jewelry. The background has textured, parallel lines creating a gradient effect. The portrait is framed by an oval border with an intricate design at the bottom, featuring a coat of arms and two lion-like figures.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person has their head tilted upwards, eyes gazing towards the sky. Their facial features include a long, straight nose, high cheekbones, and a slightly open mouth. They have long, wavy, dark hair cascading around the shoulders. The person is wearing a crown of thorns and has a beard. They are clothed in a simple draped garment with texture indicated by shading. The scene is framed by an oval shape and rays emanate from the head, creating a halo effect. The background is composed of etched lines, providing a gradient effect and depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Christ Full-Length
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright on a stylized rock or mound. The person is facing forward with the left hand raised and fingers extended, and the right hand lowered. He has long, wavy hair, a beard, and a mustache. The clothing is a long, flowing robe with deep folds draped around his body. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain. At the bottom of the illustration, there is a block of text in Latin.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The engraving shows three figures: two adults and an infant. On the left, a kneeling adult faces the other figures. The adult on the right sits, holding the unclothed infant. The figures are in a simple setting with draped fabric, stones, a column on the left, and a donkey in the background. Natural elements like branches are also visible. A stone slab on the ground bears inscribed text.

artworks.title: Vincent Voiture
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait with his upper body, including shoulders and part of his chest, visible. He faces the viewer with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has a mustache, narrow beard, long and narrow nose, high cheekbones, slender lips, and long wavy hair falling past his shoulders. He wears a collared shirt with a bow and a jacket with ornate patterns on the sleeves. The portrait frame is oval with engravings, and the background has a cross-hatched texture. Below the portrait is a rectangular plaque with script text.

artworks.title: Marechal de Turenne
artworks.description: This image shows a half-length portrait of a man dressed in historical attire within an oval frame. The man is positioned slightly angled towards the left with a steady gaze directed at the viewer. He has a mustache and a pointed goatee, long wavy hair, and wears an elaborate lace collar over a detailed jacket. There are castle turret illustrations in the background corners and stenciled text within the frame.

artworks.title: Claude Thevenin
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, looking at the viewer. The man has an aged face with prominent features, light wavy hair down to his collar, and is dressed in a clerical robe with a white clerical collar over a darker garment. Latin text surrounds the oval frame holding the portrait. Below the portrait, there is a coat of arms in a circular design. The background has fine line work for a textured effect.

artworks.title: Claude Thevenin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up in a classic three-quarter view turned slightly to his right. He has a direct gaze with eyes looking towards the viewer's left. His facial features include a broad forehead, prominent eyes, and slightly downturned lips. The man has medium-length curly hair worn beneath a small cap and wears traditional ecclesiastical clothing. The background is a plain, dark oval contrasting with the lighter tones of his face and attire. A decorative oval frame surrounds the image, inscribed with text identifying the individual portrayed.

artworks.title: Denis Talon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-length portrait positioned to the left, with long wavy hair falling to his shoulders. His facial features include a straight nose, a composed expression, and a slight smile. He wears traditional attire consisting of a wide-collared shirt, a dark gown with buttons, and a draped outer garment. The framed portrait is bordered with an oak leaf and acorn motif, decorative medallions in the corners, and a central crest above and below. The background is unobtrusive.

artworks.title: Louis-Francois de La Baume de Suze
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body, including his head and shoulders. The man is depicted in a partial profile, turned slightly to the left, with curly hair framing his face, a receding hairline, a pointed nose, and thin lips. He is wearing clerical clothing with a cross necklace and the portrait is set within an ornate oval frame with inscriptions and a coat of arms below it. The background within the oval is a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Christina, Queen of Sweden
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a person from the torso upwards. The figure is positioned slightly turned to their left with their head facing the viewer in a three-quarter view. They have long, curly hair, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and full lips. The person is dressed in a garment with a flowing cloth over their shoulders, fastened with a ribbon, and a high-collared shirt underneath. The portrait is framed within an oval, ornate border with ribbon-like decorations. The background features vertical lines within the oval, while the outer area is plain. Below the oval, there is an inscription in French, and the artist's name is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Alexander de Seve
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in a slight three-quarter view, with long wavy hair, a well-groomed mustache and goatee. He wears a dark garment with a high rounded collar and a decorative ribbon tied at the neck. An oval frame with an inscription surrounds him. At the bottom, there is an elaborate coat of arms. The background has a lined pattern that contrasts with the man's clothing and hair, emphasizing the figure within the ornate border.

artworks.title: Francois de la Mothe Le Vayer
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting an upper body portrait of a man. He is facing forward with his upper body slightly turned to his left. The man has a long narrow face with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, thin lips, and shoulder-length, wavy hair. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with decorative frilled edging and a buttoned garment with large, puffed sleeves. The portrait is within an oval frame on a wall, with a plinth below it that bears an inscription: 'FRANCISCVS. MOTHAEVS VAYERIVS REGI A CONSILIS FRATRIQVE EIVS VNICO A STVDIIS. 1661'.

artworks.title: Marechal de Turenne
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man from the chest up. The person is positioned angled slightly to the side, looking directly at the viewer. He has defined facial features, a mustache, pointed goatee, and long, wavy hair. He is wearing a richly adorned garment with a fur-lined cape or cloak draped over his shoulder, suggesting a high-ranking status. The portrait is contained within an elegant oval frame, decorated with ornate details and a coat of arms flanked by two heraldic lions at the bottom. The background has a textured pattern, and surrounding the frame is the text "HENRY DE LATOUR DAUVERGNE VICOMTE DE."

artworks.title: Anne of Austria, Queen of France and Navarre
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman's body. She is facing slightly to her left but gazes directly at the viewer. She has a full face with softly downturned eyes, a straight nose, and a small mouth. Her curly hair is styled in medium-length ringlets, covered by a small cap or headpiece towards the back of her head. She wears an ornate dress with a high, rounded neckline and delicate lace edging. A large, elaborate brooch or cross is pinned at her chest, and she has a string of pearls around her neck. The background is a simple, uniform dark shade. The oval frame around the portrait is adorned with text and two fleur-de-lis.

artworks.title: Rene, Marquis de Maisons
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man, shown from the upper body up. He is slightly turned to the left but facing forward, with a mustache, defined eyes, curly hair just above his shoulders, and a subtle smile. He wears a garment with a fur collar and patterned fabric underneath, suggesting formal or ceremonial attire. There is no visible jewelry, but the clothing is ornate. The background features an oval frame within a rectangular border with a distinct pattern, and a decorative coat of arms at the bottom of the oval frame. The overall texture of the portrait indicates it is an engraving, displaying intricate lines and shading for detail.

artworks.title: Rene, Marquis de Maisons
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man within an oval border. The man faces slightly left, with curly, shoulder-length hair, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. He wears a draped garment with a textured pattern on his shoulders. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background has a textured pattern, and the outer frame includes text and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Rene, Marquis de Maisons
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man in historical clothing. He faces left, has medium-length wavy hair, and a subtle smile. The portrait is set within an oval frame with decorative engravings and a coat of arms at the base. The style is detailed and indicative of the period depicted. There is no specific background in the image.

artworks.title: Francois Mallier du Houssay
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual from the chest up in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the left. The individual is a middle-aged man with specific facial characteristics, a robe with intricate details, a large white collar, a cross on a chain around his neck, and a coat of arms below the oval frame. The background of the image consists of finely drawn parallel lines.

artworks.title: Charles II, Duc de Mantoue
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing an upper-body view of a man in a formal pose. His head is slightly turned to the right, and his gaze is directed at the viewer. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair that is parted in the middle, framing his face. His facial features are delicately defined, with slender eyebrows, a long nose, and full lips. He wears an elaborate outfit typical of historical aristocracy, featuring a richly adorned cloak fastened with a chain, over a garment with a lace collar. A necklace with a pendant hangs prominently on his chest. The portrait is encased in an oval frame that is part of the engraving, and the background is dark with a hatched texture. Beneath the image, there is a caption with text identifying the individual as Charles II, Duke of Mantua and other titles.

artworks.title: Pierre de Maridat
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man at a three-quarter angle, looking towards the left. He has a long face, prominent nose, mustache, and wavy hair falling around his shoulders. The man wears 17th-century attire with a high-collared shirt and decorative clasp. The portrait is framed within an oval border with ornate text, and detailed line work fills the background. Additional text below the frame provides details in classic script.
